setting.sl: Družinski hotel ob Baškem jezeru (Faaker See) za sezono od maja do oktobra išče sodelavca ali sodelavko na recepciji. Veliko gostov prihaja iz Slovenije in Italije. {m:Prijavil|f:Prijavila} si se in direktorica hotela te je povabila na razgovor.
setting.en: A family hotel on the Faaker See is looking for someone at reception for the season, May to October. Many of its guests come from Slovenia and Italy. You applied, and the hotel's manager has invited you to an interview.
setting.it: Un albergo a conduzione familiare sul lago di Faak cerca una persona per la reception per la stagione, da maggio a ottobre. Molti ospiti arrivano dalla Slovenia e dall'Italia. Ti sei {m:candidato|f:candidata} e la direttrice dell'albergo ti ha {m:invitato|f:invitata} a un colloquio.

role: Frau Kowatsch, the manager of a family hotel on the Faaker See, hiring for reception. Friendly and direct: asks why this hotel, about experience, how {learner} would handle a guest's complaint, strengths and weaknesses; answers on shifts, pay by the collective agreement, a staff room. Says Sie.
speaker: teacher

goals.de: Stell dich vor und sag, warum du dich bewirbst
goals.sl: Predstavi se in povej, zakaj se prijavljaš
goals.en: Introduce yourself and say why you're applying
goals.it: Presentati e di' perché ti candidi

goals.de: Erzähl von deiner Erfahrung und deinen Stärken
goals.sl: Povej o svojih izkušnjah in močnih straneh
goals.en: Talk about your experience and your strengths
goals.it: Racconta la tua esperienza e i tuoi punti di forza

goals.de: Sag, wie du mit einem schwierigen Gast umgehen würdest
goals.sl: Povej, kako bi {m:ravnal|f:ravnala} s težavnim gostom
goals.en: Say how you would deal with a difficult guest
goals.it: Di' come ti comporteresti con un ospite difficile

goals.de: Frag nach Arbeitszeit, Gehalt und Art der Stelle
goals.sl: Vprašaj za delovni čas, plačo in vrsto zaposlitve
goals.en: Ask about the hours, the pay and the kind of job
goals.it: Chiedi dell'orario, dello stipendio e del tipo di contratto

goals.de: Bedank dich und frag, wie es weitergeht
goals.sl: Zahvali se in vprašaj, kaj sledi
goals.en: Thank her and ask what happens next
goals.it: Ringrazia e chiedi come si procede

opener_sl: Grüß Gott, schön, dass Sie da sind. Bitte, nehmen Sie Platz. Ihre Bewerbung habe ich schon gelesen. Erzählen Sie mir zuerst: Warum gerade wir?

opener_en.sl: Dober dan, lepo, da ste prišli. Prosim, sedite. Vašo prijavo sem že prebrala. Najprej mi povejte: zakaj ravno mi?
opener_en.en: Good morning, I'm glad you could come. Please, have a seat. I've already read your application. Tell me first: why us?
opener_en.it: Buongiorno, mi fa piacere che sia {m:venuto|f:venuta}. Prego, si accomodi. Ho già letto la sua candidatura. Mi dica prima di tutto: perché proprio noi?
